race.comment: Open race to close out the card. ALPHABET (13) finally shed the maiden tag at Scone last time out and will have derived a bunch of confidence from that breakthrough victory. Drawn to get all the favours from the inside marble and should be right there when the judge calls a halt. CRASH BANG WALLOP (12) got the job done at his second career outing and can go right on with it. The well-related TANNIN (10) (half to G2 winner Cinsault) strips fitter second-up from the spell and should be ready to show something now. HERMAN SAID (3) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be slept on.
